question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about vinegar?

options.text: Vinegar is a combination of acetic acid and water.
It can be used as a food preservative.
It is a combination of acetic acid and formic acid.

solution:
The incorrect answer is __Option 3__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A high-quality sugarcane original vinegar drink was produced from fresh sugarcane juice using the wine yeast and LB acetate bacteria by submerged alcoholic fermentation followed by acetic fermentation at room temperature.
 
• It is produced by** 2-step fermentation.**
 
• Vinegar is essentially a dilute solution of **acetic (ethanoic) acid in water**.
 
• Vinegar is used as a preservative for both domestic use and in the food industry.
 
• Formic acid is not present in Vinegar__. __**Hence, option 3 is false.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Acetic acid is produced by the oxidation of ethanol by acetic acid bacteria, and, in most countries, commercial production involves a double fermentation where the ethanol is produced by the fermentation of sugars by yeast.
